rationale: Stable v1.82.0 already represents devices as LED strips, but its topology overlay accepts only HTMLElement/.dev endpoints. Restore the existing real-radio diagnostic for LED SVG targets using the agreed visible-path midpoint, fixed-screen halo and actual-shape paint; no topology source, permission, storage or action contract changes.

summary.ru: Zigbee-связи и стрелки доступны и для устройств, показанных LED-лентой.
summary.en: Zigbee links and arrows also work for devices represented by LED strips.

golden.reason: Real directed routes between open/closed LED participants and an icon, fixed-screen midpoint halos and preserved off-core paint in Flat/light.
The same current-path endpoints and inert participant paint with raised LED bodies in 2.5D/dark.
